title: ORM Project Manifest
description: Schema for .orm-project.yaml files that define multi-domain ORM projects.

format_version.description: Format version of this project file. Optional: a file without it was written before project files were versioned and is read as 1.0. Must be "1.0" for this schema revision.

iri_base.description: The absolute IRI every domain namespace starts with: the base and the project's own segments (e.g. https://data.acme.com/acme/), ending in /. A domain's namespace is this, its context name, and /. The project name is not part of it.

dbt_project_dir.description: Path to the dbt project root, relative to the project root.

default_export_format.description: Default export format for relational mapping output.

default_export_dir.description: Default directory for export output, relative to the project root.

preferred_identifier_strategy.description: Default data type strategy for entity primary key columns when no explicit preferred identifier value type is declared. 'integer' maps to INTEGER (auto-counter), 'uuid' maps to UUID.

default_llm_model.description: Default LLM model identifier for transcript extraction (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929', 'gpt-4o', 'gpt-5-mini'). Used as the pre-selected default when the model picker is shown.

path.description: File path relative to the project root.

context.description: The bounded context name (unique within the project).

path.description: File path relative to the project root.

context.description: The bounded context name for this data product.
